title: Counting Billed Idle Hours on a Parking License
content:
**Billed idle hours** (Parking License, EV charging). How the billable idle minutes of an idle fee line are turned into billed hours depends on whether the product carries a dedicated charger — the EV Charging Reserved Space — and on how long the license has been held.

**Definition.** At a dedicated charger on a license held at least 365 days, the billable minutes are counted in completed hours and a part hour is not billed; at a dedicated charger on a license held fewer than 365 days, the billable minutes are counted in started half hours and each half hour is billed as half an hour; in every other case the billable minutes are counted in started hours.

**Days held** are the days from the license's start date to the handling date. A license held exactly 365 days is held "at least 365 days"; one held 364 days is held fewer.

## The three counting conventions side by side

| Billable minutes | Completed hours (dedicated charger, held 365 days or more) | Started half hours (dedicated charger, held fewer than 365 days) | Started hours (every other case) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 29 | 0 | 0.5 | 1 |
| 30 | 0 | 0.5 | 1 |
| 31 | 0 | 1.0 | 1 |
| 60 | 1 | 1.0 | 1 |
| 61 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 |
| 100 | 1 | 2.0 | 2 |
| 125 | 2 | 2.5 | 3 |

Reading a row: 61 billable minutes are one completed hour (the extra minute is not billed), three started half hours billed as one and a half hours, or two started hours.
